# ExactEvolutionLaw

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A closed-form differential equation governing the time evolution of action-weighted path ensembles without approximation, derived from first principles. Enables precise prediction of topological state transitions in computing networks, crucial for designing adaptive and self-organizing architectures.
